summary: Enhance your skills in data lake management with our comprehensive training program. Learn from industry experts and stay ahead in the competitive field.
lede: Data lake management equips data engineers, architects, governance analysts, and analytics professionals to organize and control data for reporting and machine learning. It covers ingestion and lake-zone design, cataloging and lineage, data-quality checks and access controls, and performance and cost monitoring to help keep datasets usable, traceable, and governed.
audienceIntro: This training is designed for professionals who manage, design, govern, or analyze data lake environments and need practical control over ingestion, storage, cataloging, security, and performance.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of data concepts, SQL, file formats such as CSV and Parquet, and basic cloud storage terminology. Familiarity with ETL or ELT workflows is helpful, but coding is not required for completion. Advanced implementation topics such as automated cataloging and AI-assisted data quality monitoring are covered at operational awareness and applied design level, not production engineering depth.
